instruction: Can you change the VLC volume slider to a green color scheme? I prefer a more vibrant look that stands out better against the default interface.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the VLC volume slider to a green color scheme. Uses existing check_qt_slider_colours metric function with type='match' to verify the qt-slider-colours setting matches the expected green color pattern (50;200;50;30;180;30;40;220;40;45;190;45) representing 4 RGB colors in greenish tones.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) using get_vlc_config which retrieves the platform-specific config path and downloads the file
Metric function check_qt_slider_colours correctly parses the config file and checks the qt-slider-colours setting with type='match' comparison

Expected value '50;200;50;30;180;30;40;220;40;45;190;45' represents 4 green RGB colors (50,200,50 | 30,180,30 | 40,220,40 | 45,190,45) which semantically matches the instruction requirement for 'green color scheme' that is 'more vibrant'
Metric parameter handling is correct: function receives rule dict directly (not wrapped) and accesses rule['type'] and rule['expected_qt_slider_colours'] correctly
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (change slider to green) is fully verified by checking the qt-slider-colours config setting
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are persisted to disk before verification
